full_prompt_en: A square isometric architectural illustration presents a compact cluster of stepped urban volumes on a gridded platform. A tall central tower rises above shorter rectangular blocks, while several low annexes extend toward the front and sides. Parallel vertical edges and two consistent diagonal ground axes organize every form, so the cluster reads as a measured axonometric object rather than a camera view. Muted coral-pink roof planes cap selected blocks; warm ocher, cream, teal-blue, and gray faces distinguish the others. Thin dark outlines define corners, windows, and the edges of the base. Some linework continues beyond the solids as an exposed construction grid, including light diagonals and vertical guides on the warm cream background. The tall block carries narrow repeating window marks, while lower masses use simpler rectangular divisions. Soft gray shadows fall to one side of each volume, clarifying stacked height without creating dramatic lighting. The entire object floats in a generous field of blank paper, with no sky, horizon, or surrounding street. Fine hatching and subtle paper grain bring tactile detail to surfaces that are otherwise cleanly colored. The vertical stack creates a strong center, balanced by lower pieces spread across the base, and the grid visually ties them together. The illustration feels simultaneously technical and playful: exact parallel geometry supports a small palette of cheerful muted colors. The overall composition is orderly and airy, using a precise isometric system to make a complex cluster easy to understand at a glance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形等轴测建筑插画在网格底座上呈现一组紧凑、逐级升高的城市体块。一座高塔超过周围较低的矩形块，数个矮附属块向前方与两侧延伸。平行的竖直边和两组一致的地面斜轴组织全部形态，使这组结构读作经过测量的轴测对象，而非相机视角。低饱和珊瑚粉屋顶盖住部分体块；暖赭、奶油色、青蓝与灰色立面区分其余部分。细深色轮廓标出角部、窗和底座边缘。有些线条越过实体继续延伸，成为外露结构网格，包括暖奶油背景上的浅斜线和竖向辅助线。高体块带有重复的窄窗标记，低体块则采用更简洁的矩形分隔。柔和灰影落向各体块一侧，说明堆叠高度，却不形成戏剧性照明。整个对象漂浮在宽阔空白纸面中，没有天空、地平线或周围街道。细排线与轻微纸张颗粒为基本干净的色面增加可触细节。竖向层叠建立强中心，底座上展开的低矮部分与之平衡，网格在视觉上把各块连接起来。插画兼具技术性与玩味：精确平行几何承载一小组明快而低饱和的颜色。整体有序而轻盈，利用准确等轴测系统使复杂集合一眼易懂。
style_prompt_en: An isometric diagram illustration style uses parallel verticals, consistent paired diagonal axes, thin precise outlines, and exposed construction grids. Clean rectangular volumes are differentiated by muted coral, ocher, cream, teal-blue, and gray planes. Soft schematic side shadows explain overlap and height without dramatic perspective. Sparse hatching and paper grain temper otherwise crisp color fills. A compact central stack balances lower outward-spreading forms within generous warm-cream negative space. The result is orderly, airy, technical, and gently playful.
style_prompt_zh: 等轴测示意插画风格使用平行竖线、两组一致的斜轴、精确细轮廓和外露结构网格。干净矩形体块以低饱和珊瑚粉、赭黄、奶油色、青蓝和灰色平面相区分。柔和示意性侧影解释重叠与高度，不依靠戏剧性的透视。稀疏排线和纸张颗粒缓和本来清脆的填色。紧凑中央叠层与向外展开的低矮形态在宽阔暖奶油色负空间内平衡。成品有序、轻盈、技术感明确，又带温和玩味。
theme_en: A compact stepped urban block diagram in an isometric view
theme_zh: 一组以等轴测视角呈现的紧凑阶梯式城市街区示意图
name: Isometric projection
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
